bccd9da27047.what: The Planning Board's article would replace the zoning bylaw's accessory apartment section with rules for accessory dwelling units (ADUs). A Protected Use ADU, allowed by right under state law, could be up to half the main home's floor area or 900 square feet, whichever is smaller, with a Building Department permit. A Large Accessory Dwelling Unit (LADU) of up to 1,200 square feet would need a special permit. One ADU is allowed per lot, and either kind may be a short-term rental if the owner lives on the property. a4ba3b203a9f.what: Maureen Pollock, the planning director, briefs the Selectboard on the state's new consolidated local permitting process for small clean energy projects (225 CMR 29.00). Under the 2024 Climate Act, towns must decide a complete application within 12 months with all local permits reviewed together; if no decision is issued the project is approved by default, and appeals go to the state Energy Facilities Siting Board.
a4ba3b203a9f.who: Maureen Pollock, Director of Planning & Conservation
a4ba3b203a9f.how_to_speak: Public comment period at 6:00 PM; individuals are limited to two minutes each.
a4ba3b203a9f.line: New state permitting process for small clean energy projects: planning director briefing
a4ba3b203a9f.quote: 6. 6:25 Planning Department Business with Maureen Pollock • New consolidated local permitting process for small clean energy projects under 225 CMR 29.00 … Under the 2024 Climate Act and Department of Energy Resources (DOER) regulations (225 CMR 29.00), Massachusetts municipalities must provide a consolidated local permitting process for small clean energy projects.
a4ba3b203a9f.when_time: Monday, October 19, 2026, item at 6:25 (topics may start earlier than specified)

869d33654c02.how_to_speak: Public comment period at 6:00 PM; individuals are limited to two minutes each.
869d33654c02.line: New state permitting process for small clean energy projects: planning director briefing

869d33654c02.when_time: Monday, October 19, 2026, item at 6:25 (topics may start earlier than specified)
